reviewList.badText: A nice moisturizer for those with oily skin but dry skin types might find it lackluster in terms of moisturization.
reviewList.goodText:
Infused with Bamboo and Celtic Water to hydrate and provide relaxation to skin, this gel cream was a nice surprise as I found it lightweight but sufficient to use as a morning moisturizer. I like the way this soothes skin. 
It spreads wonderfully due to its gel texture. There’s no stickiness whatsoever, in fact there’s more of a skin-like finish once it absorbs, and it does so almost immediately.

I prefer using this in my AM routine since I like a bit of nourishment in the PM. I think those with oily skin would like this more for its ability to moisturize while also reducing sebum production on skin.
